job.title: Full Stack Engineer
job.description:
About the job

 

Full Stack Engineer | Permanent Sydney Opportunity

 

We’re partnering with a globally established organisation, supporting a diverse portfolio of commercial and consumer-facing products. This business is known for its financial strength, long-term stability, and continued investment in modern technology platforms.

 

They are now expanding their engineering capability and are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join a collaborative, product-led technology team.

 

The Opportunity

 

In this role, you’ll take ownership of features from concept through to production, working closely with technical leaders, product owners, and design teams. You’ll be part of a cloud-first engineering environment, contributing to applications that are business-critical and used at scale.

This is a hands-on role, suited to someone who enjoys end-to-end responsibility, values clean architecture, and thrives in cross-functional teams.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Deliver end-to-end full-stack solutions from design through to production
  • Convert product and business requirements into scalable, maintainable systems
  • Build responsive, accessible front-end experiences and robust backend services
  • Design and integrate secure APIs, databases, and cloud services
  • Contribute to architecture, code quality, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes
  • Support live applications through monitoring, optimisation, and issue resolution
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to sprint planning and delivery

 

Skills & Experience

 

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar
  • 5+ years’ experience in professional software development
  • Strong Angular (v17+), TypeScript, and RxJS expertise
  • Backend development experience with .NET Core (C#)
  • Proven experience delivering production-grade full-stack applications
  • Solid SQL and relational database knowledge
  • Experience with modern tooling, testing frameworks, and CI/CD

 

What’s On Offer

 

  • The chance to work within a stable, well-funded organisation undergoing technical transformation
  • Flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance
  • Ongoing learning and development support
  • A people-first culture that values inclusion, wellbeing, and professional growth

 

If you’re interested in joining a technology team where your work has real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Workforce Manager - Kronos Manager
job.description:
Workforce Manager, specifically for a Kronos (UKG) Manager.
 Key Responsibilities:
  • Technical-based manager required to lead a team of workforce administrators and technical specialists.
  • Not expected to be a deep technical expert, but rather a solutions-oriented leader who can unite technical staff and broker outcomes with business stakeholders. Strong people leader skills
  • Acts as a key liaison between the business and the technical team, translating business needs and constraints into actionable solutions. Must be able to negotiate, influence, and sometimes push back on business demands (e.g., compliance, overtime).
  • UKG/Kronos experience is a must – candidates must have significant hands-on exposure, ideally 10+ years, within large organisations reliant on time and attendance systems.
  • Experience managing direct reports, specifically workforce administrators who support business units with timecards and compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with line managers and key stakeholders across business groups.
  • Strong people management skills, including the ability to build respect, install a compliance focus, and influence managers to follow correct processes (e.g., paying overtime, accurate rostering).
  • Background in enterprise/industrial agreements and their practical application is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting rostering teams and handling BAU (business as usual) workforce management operations.
  • Manages a team of 8 (workforce administrators and technical specialists), with direct and indirect reports.
  • Works closely with technical support staff responsible for system configuration and organisational structure changes.
Key Stakeholders
  • Large people management group including business managers, P&C (People & Culture), and specific individuals such as Rostering GM, Lab Ops Manager, and HR.
  • Influences broader business messaging and ensures compliance is embedded across the organisation.
Industry Context
  • Role is suited to large, industrial, FMCG, or retail environments (not financial services or similar sectors).

job.title: Senior Power BI Developer
job.description:
The senior Power BI developer will play a pivotal role in ensuring data is at the heart of all decision making at Resimac.
As a key member of the Decision Support & Data Analytics team based in Sydney, the developer will be responsible for the development and maintenance of effective business intelligence and Resimac’s data warehouse, RDH. The developer will help develop a comprehensive and automated information reporting system that is flexible, dynamic and timely. As this position requires regular in-person engagement with stakeholders, it is essential that a successful candidate is based in Sydney.
The focus of this role is:
  • To develop and maintain the Decision Support Data and Analytics platform, enabling analytics and detailed insights into the group’s performance.
Design and develop data models to create clean, logical datasets for reporting and visualisation development

This is a senior, hands-on role focused on release governance, orchestration, and high-quality production outcomes across complex platforms.

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead and govern releases across multiple squads within a Value Stream
  • Own release planning, calendars, and enterprise release alignment
  • Drive release readiness, implementation planning, and production deployments
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise minimum control standards and release frameworks
  • Coordinate dependencies across Value Streams, Platforms, and Enterprise projects
  • Minimise post-release incidents through strong governance and operational readiness
  • Provide release reporting, metrics, and updates at enterprise forums
  • Lead post-implementation reviews and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Partner closely with Scrum Masters, Tech Leads, Test Managers, and Run teams

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong experience in Release / Implementation Management in large, complex environments
  • Hands-on experience with Agile / SAFe / DevOps / CI-CD delivery models
  • Deep understanding of release governance, environment management, and dependencies
  • Experience working with tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow, Plutora
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including senior leadership
  • Background in digital or enterprise applications (insurance experience highly regarded)

 

Nice to have:

  • Insurance domain experience (Policy, Billing, Claims, Digital platforms)
  • Exposure to technologies such as Guidewire, MuleSoft, Sitecore, MongoDB
  • ITIL, SAFe, PMP or similar certifications
